tasks.gr11-human-impact-environment-t4: Topic: Human Impact on the Environment. Cover the greenhouse effect and climate change (CO₂ and CH₄ increases, rising temperatures, extreme weather), ozone depletion (CFC role, UV radiation consequences), water pollution and eutrophication, food security threats (land degradation, monocultures), habitat destruction leading to fragmentation and species loss, loss of biodiversity, and waste management strategies (reduce, reuse, recycle). Ask Grade 11 learners to evaluate human pressures on ecosystems, interpret environmental data, and propose evidence-based mitigation strategies.
tasks.gr11-ls-revision-exam-prep-t4: Topic: Revision and Examination Practice for Life Sciences Grade 11. Integrate content across all four terms — biodiversity (plants, animals, micro-organisms), life processes (photosynthesis, cellular respiration, animal nutrition, gas exchange, excretion), and ecology (population ecology, human impact). Focus on biological drawings, graph and data interpretation, biological terminology, and answering structured and extended-response questions. Ask Grade 11 learners to answer mixed-topic questions, label diagrams, interpret data sets, and apply content to unfamiliar scenarios.
